title: Plasmid Extraction Protocol
author: Tjusls China
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.489gzz6

steps.title: Pellet cells by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Collect the E. coli culture into an EP tube and centrifuge at 12,000 rpm for 1 minute. Discard the clear supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet with P1 (RNase A)
steps.instruction: Add 250 µL of P1 (containing RNase A and stored at 4 °C) to the EP tube to fully suspend the bacterial pellet.

steps.title: Lyse cells with P2
steps.instruction: Add 250 µL of P2 to the tube and gently shake up‑and‑down 6–8 times to lyse the bacteria.

steps.title: Neutralize lysate with P3 and spin
steps.instruction: Add 350 µL of P3, invert the tube gently 6–8 times, then centrifuge at 12,000 rpm, 25 °C for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Condition column with Buffer BL
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL of Buffer BL to the CP3 adsorption column, centrifuge at 12,000 rpm for 1 minute, and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Bind DNA to column
steps.instruction: Transfer the clear supernatant (lysate) to the CP3 column and centrifuge at 12,000 rpm, 25 °C for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Wash column with PW (twice)
steps.instruction: Add 600 µL of PW to the CP3 column and centrifuge at 12,000 rpm, 25 °C for 30 seconds; repeat the addition and centrifugation once more.

substeps.instruction: Add 600 µL PW, centrifuge 30 s at 12,000 rpm, 25 °C.
Repeat the PW addition and centrifugation.

steps.title: Dry column to evaporate ethanol
steps.instruction: Move the CP3 column to a clean centrifuge tube, keep the column open for 5 minutes to allow ethanol from the PW washes to volatilize.

steps.title: Elute plasmid DNA with warm water
steps.instruction: Place 50 µL of ddH₂O pre‑heated to 65 °C onto the center of the adsorption membrane, let stand for 2 minutes, then centrifuge at 12,000 rpm for 2 minutes to collect the DNA solution in a fresh EP tube.
